reason_codes.meaning: An operative Gazette amendment has exact affected locations and a matching HKeL resulting bundle; ordinary current evidence validation must decide the text.
An operative Gazette amendment is proved but matching HKeL consolidated evidence is missing, creating a visible Coverage Gap and event route.
A published amendment takes effect after the cutoff; preserve its event while keeping pre-event text in ordinary current law.
An express Gazette correction is operative and matching HKeL resulting evidence is available for ordinary validation.
An express operative Gazette correction is proved but matching HKeL consolidated evidence is missing.
An express published correction takes effect after the cutoff; preserve the event and keep pre-event text.
A complete authentic bilingual Editorial Record is operative and matching HKeL resulting evidence is available for ordinary validation.
An operative Editorial Record is proved but matching HKeL consolidated evidence is missing, so no text is patched.
A published Editorial Record takes effect after the cutoff; preserve the event and keep pre-event text.
Authentic complete event evidence, publication/effective dates, or retained evidence fingerprints are incomplete.
The event cannot be mapped completely to exact bilingual operations and legal locations.
English and Traditional Chinese event operations do not identify the same change and locations.
The available resulting HKeL bundle does not reflect the proved operative event.
Event evidence, fact-specific source authority, event identity, timing, or resulting-bundle claims conflict.
The exact affected locations are empty, outside the instrument, or inconsistent with whole/partial scope.
